Aza’ra • The World Beneath the Veil

Aza’ra is a shattered, disc-shaped world suspended in the Void. Four continents, Dakaroth, Arzuhan, Tzaphaer and Belavadós, share the Veil, a mostly transparent magical dome. Floating islands drift above; a fractured cone twists beneath. Its sun is dead or nearly dead, and the Veil illuminates three moons. Nothing survives outside the Veil.

21 hours/day • 6 days/week • 5 weeks/month • 8 months/year • 240 days/year

Seven hours of Ae (Duvaen, red), seven hours of W’i (W'iosamn, silver), and seven hours of La (Arvalla, blue-silver and ringed).

Year 1 · Month 1/8 · Week 1/5 · Day 1/6 · W’i 13:30

W’i · W'iosamn

Play: 1 real second = 1 Aza’raan minute; no offline elapsed time is assumed. Your selected campaign date and time are stored locally. Original 24-hour NPC timetable values are not overwritten.
